notes.title: Roadmap
notes.content:
We  will be adding the following features in the next release.

1. FOV (Field of View) slider in Options Graphics tab.
2. Player voice on/off toggle in Options Audio tab.
3. NPC voice on/off toggle in Options Audio tab.

As well as any issues reported by the community.

The release is scheduled for March, 2020.
